comment: Server side of the client/server replication harness. Connection itself is driven by the process's --listen CLI arg (see the harness script that launches it), not by this config. dump_state writes state.json into this process's TMPDIR; the harness diffs it against the client's copy after both processes exit. debug_markers + physics mode are enabled so the screenshot actually shows something to eyeball (player eye markers, physics AABBs) instead of a bare view of the map.
